feature: Immediate tower D click without waiting for a ghost or preview validation reply
workshop_verified_scope: Two independent fresh Workshop games verified one-click movement of normally constructed owned towers. The first game used tower 647 with a 32.63 ms D-to-click input gap and normal cooldown, then verified occupied-wall rejection and retry without another D. A later game used tower 626 with a 32.94 ms input gap and independently confirmed zero remaining preview proxies. Both moves preserved entity identity. Profiles may already have been cached; genuine cold-profile delivery, multiplayer and UR remain simulation-only.
release_note: 修复防御塔按 D 后快速左键被吞掉的问题。有效落点无需等待预建造模型出现；服务端仍重新检查归属、距离和占格。首次资料尚未加载时保留一次点击，取消或再次按 D 会清除旧意图。
root_cause: The relocation left-click handler consumed clicks until lastValidation was current and green. A first cold D also failed if profiles or the point-target input module were not ready.
changes: Relocation submits the current snapped click immediately, independently of advisory validation, cursor settling and preview-model creation. Ordinary construction input retains its existing behavior.

A first cold D reserves a session and holds one raw click position until the profile and point-target input become available. Repeated D, Escape, right-click and selection changes invalidate that pending intent.

Only relocation can authenticate and open a fresh session at commit. It still uses the existing tower_relocation_service.move checks for ownership, real ability, alive/defeated state, cooldown, finite coordinates, exact snapped range and current occupancy.

Each result carries its session. In-flight duplicate clicks are suppressed, stale results cannot close a later D session, rejection leaves a fresh placement session available, and committed/closed sessions reject late pose and validation traffic.
NaN/infinite session numbers cannot poison the server session clock. No resource, damage, movement range, cooldown or native movement implementation was changed.

automated_checks.scope: Actual Panorama controller VM: immediate click before validation or pose, fast sweep, invalid cursor recovery, duplicate click, exact current click rather than old green position, delayed profile plus input module, stored first-click coordinates, retry after rejected destination, repeated D, stale result, Escape/right-click/selection cancellation; existing ordinary construction checks remain passing.

Actual Lua router and relocation service with engine mocks: direct cold commit without preview/pose, exact fresh grid query, ownership and engine PlayerID, ability, alive/defeated/cooldown/finite input/range, occupancy rejection, closed and newer session isolation, no late ghost resurrection, ordinary construction cannot use fresh-session admission; existing UR simulation.
Existing D/button adapter parity, repeated D and selection cancellation.
Actual shared grid modules: fixed ground-plane projection, existing model pose throttling, preloaded geometry and stale controller retirement.
Authenticated builder isolation, occupancy, static profiles, async area lifecycle and preview pose stale/closed protection.
Preview reuse, actual tower appearance, plane snapping, missing GetSkin fallback, failed setup cleanup, expiry and recovery.
Existing occupancy release and named-reservation safety contract.

deployment.scope: Only these two JS content sources were copied and compiled at the root-approved shared window. Existing content sources were backed up first; SHA256 equality was checked after compilation. No manifest or particle compilation, console connection or Workshop test was performed by this agent.

workshop_evidence.observer: Root agent performed the live input and server-state checks; this agent archived the unmodified screenshot and recorded the supplied observations.
workshop_evidence.environment: Fresh Workshop game using newly compiled UI; tower created through normal construction economy.
workshop_evidence.input_delay_scope: Measured gap between physical D keydown and left mouse button down; this is not a measurement of server move latency or frame rendering time.
workshop_evidence.profile_coldness: Not established: profile may have been cached before D. Genuine delayed-profile replay remains covered by automated simulation.

occupied_destination.input: D followed by left-click on the wall-occupied destination.

retry_without_another_d.input: After occupied-destination rejection, one left-click on a legal cell without pressing D again.

workshop_second_cold_game.observer: Root agent performed the live physical input and server queries in a later independent cold-start game; this agent read the named result logs.
workshop_second_cold_game.environment: New Workshop game with normally constructed tower 626. This is separate from the earlier tower 647 game.
workshop_second_cold_game.input_delay_scope: Root measured the physical D keydown-to-left-button-down interval. It is an input gap, not server response latency or rendering time.
workshop_second_cold_game.evidence_boundary: The zero-proxy observation applies only to this second game and is not assigned to the earlier tower 647 game. No new screenshot was created or archived for this check. Initial-profile coldness is not established; that scenario remains automated simulation coverage.

workshop_remaining_plan: Repeat D quickly and select a different valid cell, then verify that delayed old preview/result traffic neither relocates to an old cursor nor leaves a ghost after success.

Additional optional coverage: out-of-bounds and out-of-range destinations. Occupied-wall rejection and retry without another D already passed in Workshop; other invalid-cell categories remain automated coverage.
During pending placement cancel with Escape/right-click or switch selected unit; verify the pending click does not execute later.
limits: Workshop coverage is limited to the two recorded normally constructed towers and measured input gaps. The zero-proxy result belongs only to the second game. Delayed initial profiles, multiplayer, UR and all protocol permutations retain their simulation-only status.
A cold profile may delay execution until authoritative profile delivery, but the first click is retained rather than requiring another click.
Advisory red/green and ghost rendering still load asynchronously. Only a fresh server landing check authorizes movement.
